content: अक्षुण्ण {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Unbroken, uncurtailed. .²2 Not conquered or defeated, successful; अक्षुण्णोऽनुनयः <ls>Ve. 1. 2</ls>. .²3 Not trodden or beaten, unusual, strange; अभीक्ष्णमक्षुण्णतयातिदुर्गमम् <ls>Śi. 1. 32</ls> being not practised or experienced. .²4 Inexperienced, not expert.
